definitions.explanation: A scene or view that evokes a particular emotion or atmosphere. Emphasizes the emotional impression created by what is seen, not merely the visual information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{情景|じょうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful scene spread out before us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧{情景|じょうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: I can picture the scene of children playing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|えが}かれた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{情景|じょうけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: The postwar scenes depicted in the novel left a deep impression on readers' hearts.

notes:
USAGE:
{情景|じょうけい} describes a scene that carries emotional weight or atmosphere. It is often used in literary contexts to describe memorable or evocative scenes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情景|じょうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: a scene comes to mind
- {情景|じょうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to depict a scene
- {情景|じょうけい}⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧: scene description (literary term)
- ⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧{情景|じょうけい}: a nostalgic scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {情景|じょうけい}: scene (emphasizes emotional atmosphere)
- ⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧: sight, spectacle (emphasizes what is visually striking)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: scenery, landscape (natural or urban views)
- ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧: scene (a specific moment in a narrative or event)
